run_TrainingCoordinator_train: run the TrainingCoordinator to train a knowledge graph embedding model on CPU with HOGWILD parallelism
create_TrainingCoordinator: create a TrainingCoordinator instance with config, model, trainer, and evaluator for distributed CPU training
build_Trainer_process_batch: build a Trainer to process batches of edges and compute loss with backpropagation for KG embeddings
create_IterationManager: create an IterationManager to track epochs, edge paths, and edge chunks during training iterations
run_make_optimizer: run make_optimizer to create a RowAdagrad or AsyncAdagrad optimizer for model parameters or embeddings
